discussions.summary: A business owner reports useful overnight research and integrations, alongside invented claims, brittle browser automation and continuing review work.

discussions.title: Users question OpenClaw's memory reliability

discussions.title: Who is still using OpenClaw?
discussions.summary: Users share editable Obsidian memory, reminders and family-history workflows. Replies debate everyday usefulness, maintenance and consent.

onYourComputer.detail: Controls local/paired Mac desktops and cloud desktops; Windows/Linux driver support is experimental.

whileYouAreOff.detail: Depends on the deployment: a self-hosted install on your own computer stops with it, while a server install keeps running.

worksWithoutVendor.detail: Open-source software you run yourself, so it keeps running if the project stops; it still depends on whichever model provider you point it at.

remoteDisable.detail: Runs on hardware you control, with no vendor activation or licence check described.

dataAfterExit.detail: State lives on hardware you control, but a documented full export and restore path is not established.
